title: Times tables retake
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Statistics; geometry; position and direction
source: Seeded from mathematics/y4 lesson 89 (Times tables retake (portal quiz))
intro: Covers lessons 85 to 104 of Statistics; geometry; position and direction. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Key 1 picture = 20. Half a picture is...
questions.a: A) 10. Half of 20 is 10.

questions.q: Total rain in all four months?
Between which two times did it fall most?
questions.a: A) 6pm and 9pm. 19 to 14 is a fall of 5; 23 to 19 is 4.

questions.q: The scale is in 10s. Where is 45?
questions.a: A) Halfway between 40 and 50. 45 is half a step above 40.

options: The height of a candle as it burns
questions.a: A) The height of a candle as it burns. It changes over time.
A) north-east. A half turn faces the opposite direction.
A) The hands at 5 o'clock. At 5 o'clock the hands are more than a right angle apart.
A) The angle at 5 o'clock. Obtuse is larger than right, which is larger than acute.
A) all obtuse. Each is bigger than a right angle.
A) The hands at 11 o'clock. At 11 o'clock the hands are close: acute.

questions.q: Sides 4 cm, 6 cm, 7 cm. It is...
questions.a: A) scalene. No sides are equal.

questions.q: Exactly one pair of parallel sides:
questions.a: A) trapezium. Parallelograms and rectangles have two pairs.
A) a square. Only the square has equal sides and equal angles.

questions.q: Lines of symmetry in an equilateral triangle?
questions.a: A) 3. One from each corner to the middle of the opposite side.

questions.q: A point touches the mirror line. Its reflection is...
questions.a: A) in the same place. Distance 0 stays 0.

questions.q: The point 6 across and 1 up is...
questions.a: A) (6, 1). Across first, then up.
